rows.question: What qualification is needed for RBI Grade B?
rows.answer: For the post of Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) - General, candidates require either a Graduation in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD) or a Post-Graduation in any discipline with a minimum of 55% marks [51]. The graduation course must be of at least 3 years' duration, and the post-graduation course must be of at least 2 years' duration from a recognized University or Institute [51]. For the DEPR and DSIM cadres, the minimum educational qualifications include a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline, a Master's Degree with Research/Teaching experience, or a Ph.D. [21][22][23][33][34][35][36][37][38].

rows.question: What is the age limit for IBPS Clerk?
rows.answer: The age limit for the IBPS Clerk (CSA) position is 20-28 years [10]. Additionally, an age limit of 35-38 years is also specified [11].

rows.question: What is the application fee for IBPS PO?
rows.answer: The application fee for IBPS PO is Rs. 175/- (inclusive of GST) for SC/ST/PwBD candidates [16] [55] and Rs. 850/- (inclusive of GST) for all other candidates [17] [55]. Bank transaction charges for the online payment must be borne by the candidate [55].

rows.question: What qualification is needed for SSC CHSL?
rows.answer: For SSC CHSL posts, candidates are required to have passed the 12th Standard in the Science stream with Mathematics as a subject from a recognized Board or equivalent [11][13][15][17]. Additionally, a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognized by the Government of India or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government is required [12][14][16][18].

rows.question: What is the age limit for SSC CHSL?
rows.answer: The age limit for SSC CHSL is 18 to 27 years [19][20][21][22].

rows.question: What is the age limit for RBI Grade B?
rows.answer: The age limit for the RBI Grade B (DR) DEPR/DSIM cadre is 21 to 30 years [48]. The upper age limit is relaxed to 32 years for candidates with an M.Phil. and 34 years for those with a Ph.D. [53]. Additionally, the upper age limit is relaxed to 33 years for candidates with experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks, Public Sector Insurance Companies, All India Financial Institutions, or the Reserve Bank of India [53]. Candidates with a Master's Degree and Research/Teaching experience are eligible for a relaxation in the upper age limit up to a maximum of three years [51].
